Table assignment scope: /subscriptions/<subscription>/resourceGroups/<resource-group>/providers/Microsoft.Storage/storageAccounts/<storage-account>/tableServices/default/tables/<table-name>.
Portal does not currently support table-scoped role assignment; use CLI, PowerShell or ARM. Role changes may take up to 10 minutes. Table scope covers the table, not an individual entity.
